_schema: LEGEND Benchmark I · fixture spec v1 — the curated INPUT to `claim_retrieval_bench.py build`
_what_is_curated_here: Only the historical event (commit + triggering PMID), the quality class, the relationship and the reason. The TARGET CLAIM SET is not written here: `build` derives it from the claim-registry diff of the event commit by one declared rule (see `labeling_rule`), so a label cannot be chosen by looking at what retrieval returns. The one manual override is declared with its evidence in `target_override`.
labeling_rule: A claim is a target of (commit C, PMID P) when it exists at C^ and its record changed in C, and the number of references to P in the record's ADDED diff lines exceeds the number in its REMOVED lines. A reference is the PMID string or a wikilink `#<ID>]]` to any paper-registry record whose Identifier at C names P.
seed_rule:
The first-pass observation text is the `verbatim_locators.entries[*].snippet` of `disease-models/wwox/research/deepdive_manifests/PMID

.json` AT C^ — the reading as it stood before the canonical change landed. Snippets are the source's own words (or a reader's attestation of a figure panel); they are written while the document is open, before comparison (fulltext_read_receipt.md). Scrubbed before use: any `CLAIM nnn` token and any `[[wikilink]]`, each counted. The propositions are NOT the primary seed, because they are the reader's framing and may carry LEGEND wording; they are reported as a secondary seed only.

cases.why: BATCH_20260806_001 (MAJOR): the full-text read of CLAIM 005's own source deleted an unsupported GABAergic-caution clinical meaning and narrowed the claim (commit message + CC-20260806-30290271).

BATCH_20260806_002: the survey that CLAIM 005's imported epileptogenesis premise rested on states Wwox-null mice show no epilepsy; the premise was traced and contradicted (commit message 'THE FINDING').
BATCH_20260806_002: Tochigi 2019 is postnatal (PND5-21); both prenatal-development claims received an evidence boundary saying it contributes maturation/hypomyelination, not prenatal migration.
BATCH_20260810_001: CLAIM 004 set to `flagged for review` because the full read of its own source showed the rescue is incomplete where compared to wild type.
BATCH_20260810_003: muscle-specific Wwox KO added to CLAIM 009 as supporting evidence with two explicit boundaries (not CNS; no glucose-oxidation measurement).

BATCH_20260810_005: the locators of PMID 34747138 returned CLAIM 004 to consolidated baseline with its comparator stated, and bounded CLAIM 003's non-cell-autonomy (oligodendrocytes never transduced; incomplete recovery).
BATCH_20260810_005: the figure locator of Cheng 2020 (Fig 7b) shows lithium suppressed PTZ seizures in all three genotypes; CLAIM 016's lithium arm is not genotype-specific.
BATCH_20260810_005 promoted this review to PAPER 063 and cited it in CLAIM 016's boundary and in CLAIM 003/004 links.
cases.limitation: A REVIEW whose role in CLAIM 003/004 is a wikilink added in the same batch as I06; its contribution is secondary and partly bibliographic.

cases.why: BATCH_20260815_001: fly Wwox genetics (Wwox x Idh / Sod) added as counter-directional redox evidence to CLAIM 009 and as independent support for CLAIM 034's context-dependence.
BATCH_20260815_001: heterozygotes unremarkable unchallenged but tumour-susceptible after NMBA/ENU — CLAIM 032 (haploinsufficiency not deleterious) qualified.
BATCH_20260815_001: the same heterozygote-susceptibility qualification on CLAIM 032, and early systemic collapse / osteosarcoma qualification on CLAIM 036.
BATCH_20260815_001: reproduces early systemic collapse with bone/endocrine abnormalities without separating local from systemic causes — CLAIM 036 qualified.
BATCH_20260815_001: endocrine/pituitary findings in the null mouse added to CLAIM 036's qualification.
BATCH_20260815_001: CLAIM 011's own source, read with S1-S8: long-term expression regionally uneven and supraphysiological; P300 survivor-selected.
BATCH_20260909_001: CLAIM 002's cortical-layering evidence boundary reads Figure 4H and Appendix Table S1 / Fig S3C of Steinberg 2021 (EMBO Mol Med) = PAPER 039, the claim's own source.
cases.limitation: The labeling rule does not fire: the addition names the figures, not the PMID or PAPER 039, so the target is a declared manual override.
cases.override_evidence: The added text quotes 'compared with WWOX-KO COs' and 'prevents these changes to some extent' and names Figure 4H, Appendix Table S1 and Appendix Fig S3C; CLAIM 002's pre-existing Source field reads 'Steinberg et al., 2021, EMBO Molecular Medicine' and its Wikilinks carry PAPER 039, whose Identifier is PMID 34268881.

cases.why: BATCH_20260909_001: Banne 2021 review — long survival inside DEE28 (CLAIM 017), Q230P homozygous census (CLAIM 019), the P47R compound-het genotype (CLAIM 030), and a non-uniform AED-refractory premise (CLAIM 033). A multi-target fixture.
BATCH_20260909_001: identified as the primary source of CLAIM 023's mechanism; no experiment manipulates phosphorylation and measures localisation — the consolidated title was narrowed.
BATCH_20260909_001: Fu 2011 (Blood) corroborates CLAIM 023's binding-independence leg from an independent group (Y33R binds Tax and still fails to suppress it).
BATCH_20260909_001: HIF1alpha axis confirmed in vivo in liver with two boundaries (five promoters only; context-dependent gene set) on CLAIM 025.
BATCH_20260909_001: counter-directional mutation-burden observation qualifying the genome-stability leg of CLAIM 029 (explicitly not a reversal).
BATCH_20260909_001: Abu-Remaileh 2015 Figure 2B independently corroborates the P47R compound-het reading on CLAIM 030 (with a non-independence warning).
BATCH_20260909_001: Kurek 2010 — the 100% osteosarcoma figure is 19/22 = 86% in its own Figure S1 legend; CLAIM 036's conflict narrowed.

BATCH_20260909_001: Del Mare 2011 review disposes of both independent osteosarcoma negatives by an untested method-insensitivity attribution; recorded on CLAIM 036 with a PREMISE and a REVIVAL_TRIGGER.
BATCH_20260921_001: CLAIM 039's cerebellar limb narrowed — the exclusion rests on one modal sentence of this paper's Discussion ('we did not detect any marked pathologic changes in the cerebella').
BATCH_20260922_SEIZURE (MAJOR): electrographic seizures in the Wwox-null mouse deleted CLAIM 037's 'explicitly absent in Wwox-null mice' clause and retargeted CLAIM 005's prohibition.
cases.limitation: A synthesis over four first-hand datasets (Cheng 2020, Hussain 2023, Obeid 2026, Repudi 2021); this PMID is one of several jointly responsible sources, so its seed alone may not carry the whole trigger.

Triggered by PMID 24369382, held at abstract depth only; the body fetch returned empty and no deepdive manifest exists, so no first-pass observation text is reconstructable from the repository.

An operator-approved narrowing of an absolute ('no phenotype' -> 'on the endpoints measured') from an audit across sources; no single first-pass source text to seed from.
A cross-reference ('solo rimando') to CLAIM 037/040 added by the seizure batch; nothing in CLAIM 016 changes.

Cheng 2020 was re-verified in this batch but its locators predate the batch (already used in I07); the new trigger was the electrographic data — kept as I25 via PMID 42422765 only, so the same event is not counted twice.
PMID 42422765 had no deepdive manifest at ec7c09f^; the first-pass state is not reconstructable.
Not invalid — split into I09-I14 by triggering PMID. Listed so the batch is visibly accounted for.
Cited in the additions as context (a prior read, the conditional-allele paper) rather than as the triggering observation; the triggering sources are I22 and I23.

no_change_control.why: The Author Correction of PMID 29724996 (H&E duplication in Fig 3a/3d). Its receipt FTR-20260909-30470736-01 checked the 38 locators of the corrected article and found none on the corrected panels; the registry record declares 'Claim links: none'. The audited outcome was: no claim changes. Used ONLY in I2, as the true no-change case; it has no retrieval target and is excluded from I1 recall.
